requirements.title: ATANH complex result imaginary part is radian-valued and bounded
requirements.definition: ATANH(X) approximates the inverse hyperbolic tangent of X; if the result is complex, its imaginary part is expressed in radians and lies in the range -pi/2 through pi/2.

pending.atanh-complex-imaginary-radian-range: Concrete plan: call ATANH with complex X values initialized away from default-equivalent zero, store AIMAG of the result into a sentinel variable, and assert only membership in the source-stated [-pi/2, pi/2] interval; no approximation error is asserted.
